title: AI systems most at risk of cybersecurity attacks, PwC report shows
why_it_matters_hint: Only the headline could be read: a PwC report says AI systems are among the most at risk from cyberattacks.
notes: Finextra returned HTTP 403. One Google News search found no other outlet with the text. A WealthBriefing piece dated 5 Oct 2026 reports a PwC survey on cyber budgets rising as AI threats grow; it may be the same PwC work (not confirmed), which would put the event before 7 Oct.
